question: Should OpenClaw accept `SourceActor` plus the `SourceActor*` scalar mirrors as the public channel/plugin SDK attribution contract for this stack?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and tested, but this is an additive public SDK and prompt context surface whose permanent shape affects plugin authors, prompt templates, and downstream memory integrations.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Keep the attribution contract direction, land or replace the Signal prerequisites first, and review this PR as the isolated source actor API.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Keep attribution internal or reduce scalar mirror exposure until maintainers decide which fields should be stable public SDK API.

options.title: Pause For Memory Direction
options.body: Defer this contract until the downstream memory attribution shape confirms which source actor fields are actually needed.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the attribution contract direction, land or replace the Signal prerequisites first, and review this PR as the isolated source actor API.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent ownership of the inbound context, templating, and SDK channel documentation surfaces that define this public contract.
